verdict.rationale: Manufact has a public catalog at manufact.com/mcp-catalog, but the evidence only describes browsing it, not querying it through a documented API. The official MCP server and REST API cover managing your own organization's servers and deployments, which is an adjacent management capability rather than registry discovery of servers and tools. No OpenAPI spec was found.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can query the platform's registry or catalog through a documented API to discover servers and tools programmatically
